name: Cursed Love
source:
The story starts with you returning home after finishing college abroad; your mother is sick, your father is useless, and your sisters just left.

Now it's up to you to fix things in the house, your goal is to kick out your father and subjugate your mother, many friends and enemies from the past will also show up in the city, along with some new faces from elsewhere.

Will you be able to take control of your house and build your harem?​

[From F95 Zone]
translation:
故事从你在国外读完大学回国开始；你的母亲病了，你的父亲无用，你的姐妹们刚刚离开。

现在你要解决房子里的事情，你的目标是赶走你的父亲，征服你的母亲，许多过去的朋友和敌人也会出现在这座城市里，还有一些来自其他地方的新面孔。

你能掌控你的房子并建立你的后宫吗？​

[来自F95区]
